recentItems.title: Shashi Tharoor’s UNFILTERED take on Dhurandhar: 'Some Of The Most Disgusting Scenes’
recentItems.description:
Shashi Tharoor reviews Ranveer Singh’s Dhurandhar franchise, praising its filmmaking while criticising its graphic violence and political messaging. The Congress MP calls some scenes among the most disturbing in Indian cinema and raises questions about the film’s portrayal of India-Pakistan relations. Watch the complete video to know more

recentItems.title: Durga Puja 2026: Nysa Devgan, Rupali Ganguly, Gaurav Khanna, Adrija Roy seek Maa Durga's blessings
recentItems.description:

recentItems.description:

The actor liked a Heropanti clip featuring Kriti Sanon with a cryptic ‘Zindagi Bhar Ke Liye Gayab’ caption.
